versions.changelog:
Initial release of adaptive-expert-interview skill.

- Enables adaptive, multi-round interviews with domain experts to generate structured Q&A pairs.
- Automates interview workflow: initialization, status tracking, question generation, response analysis, and result export.
- Supports progressive questioning, customizable interview focus, and interruption/resume functionality.
- Outputs standardized Q&A pairs in JSONL format for easy further analysis.
